item.title: Number of Nebraska farms, ranches down by 200 in 2019 from the previous year
item.description: GRAND ISLAND, Neb. — After a year of massive flooding throughout Nebraska and continued low commodity prices, the USDA reported Thursday that the number of farms in Nebraska declined in 2019 from 2018.

item.title: Former Fremont superintendent remembered for leadership, commitment to students
item.description: Stephen Sexton, who served as Fremont Public Schools superintendent from 1997 to 2014, died Sunday at age 84. He is remembered for the many ways his leadership grew the district.
